contexts.text: Inflow by vibrations and reciprocations as it were linear. SE 1183 a.
The reciprocal union of the Divine and the Human essence. AC 2011. AC 2665:end.
The unition was made reciprocally. Explained.
This reciprocal union. Illustrated.
Man's reciprocal [love] to the Lord. Representation. AC 2177:8.
Man's Reciprocal, and appropriation. Representation.
A species of reciprocation in the Prophets. Explained.
What is reciprocal. Signified. AC 3070. AC 3090.
For conjugial love is mutual and reciprocal...
The union of the Divine and the Human in the Lord is mutual and in turn, or reciprocal...
A reciprocal state with those of the new Church. Signified.
What is reciprocal with those of the Church. Signified. The Reciprocal is the belief that redemption is of the Lord alone.
The Reciprocal of truth when to be conjoined with good, appears from marriages... in that there is consent on both sides; and this derives its origin from the marriage of good and truth...
What is reciprocal as to the illustration of all the scientifics in the natural man. Signified, Explained.
Reciprocal freedom. Signified, Explained.
The reciprocal intention of the affection of truth. Signified, Explained.

The Lord's body = His Divine love, and the Reciprocal with man, such as is the love with the celestial Angels; and His blood = His Divine love, and the Reciprocal with man, such as is the love with the spiritual Angels.
What is reciprocal of the affections of truth. Signified, Explained.

When bread is mentioned, the Angels perceive the Lord... consequently His love towards the universal human race, and at the same time the reciprocal love of man to the Lord; for these cohere in one idea of thought and affection.
In order that the Reciprocal of affection might be insinuated. Signified, Explained.
The Reciprocal of conjunction with a condition. Signified.
For in order that the Church may be in a nation there must be a Reciprocal.
Thus, as there is a Reciprocal in man, there is reception; which is impossible with beasts.
As man can not only receive the Divine, but also appropriate it to himself by acknowledgement and affection-thus by what is reciprocal-therefore man can never die.
Reciprocal influx into the goods from a spiritual origin there. Signified, Explained.
The Holy Supper was instituted in order to represent the Lord's love towards the universal human race; and the reciprocal [love] of man towards Him.
The reciprocal conjunction of good and truth is the heavenly marriage.
The mode of operating of these (Spirits) is by quick reciprocations...
Reciprocal perception. Signified.
As yet there is no reciprocal communication (between the Internal and the External). When this takes place, there is conjunction.
Reception, and thence what is reciprocal. Signified, Explained.
The reciprocal conjunction of truths with good. Explained.
Reciprocal communication from reception. Signified.
In its first origin, spiritual heat is... the Divine love towards the universal human race; and the consequent reciprocal [love] of man to Him...
The Reciprocal of initiation and conjunction of the scientifics of the Church with the truths and goods in the Natural. Signified, Explained.
For all conjunction must be reciprocal...
Every agent has its reagent or Reciprocal...
Miriam answered them = what is reciprocal... Their responsive singing represented what is reciprocal...
For reception is the Reciprocal of influx...
The Reciprocal which was in the response. Signified, Explained.
When there are conjunction and unition, then there is a Reciprocal; for good acts, and truth reacts; reaction is the Reciprocal which is in the response.
(Thus is it) with the Reciprocal of man when the Divine inflows...
That with those in the Church good and truth are to be conjoined according to order, thus reciprocally, truth with good, and good with truth. Signified.
The reciprocation of good and truth with man...
For reciprocal influx, namely, from man to the Lord, which is called physical influx, is impossible.
The reciprocal marriage of truth with good, and of good with truth. Representation, and Shown by an Example(s).

The reciprocal communication of truth with good and of good with truth. Representation. For the communications must be reciprocal, in order that there may be a conjugial conjunction of truth and good. AC 9607. AC 9609.
Thus the glorification, or unition, was reciprocal. Signified. AC 10067:5, Illustrated. DLord 35:8, Illustrated. TCR 99.
It is the like with every unition: it is not full unless it is reciprocal.
To love anyone and be conjoined with him, who has no Reciprocal, is impossible... As the reception and Reciprocal in man are from the Lord, He says... Illustrated.

As this Reciprocal... is with man from the Lord... man must repent... must do His precepts... must render an account of his works... and must examine himself, confess his sins, desist from them, and lead a new life. DLife 104. DLife 105. DLife 106.
If there were no Reciprocal with man, there would be no imputation.
The Divine love and wisdom are a one because their union is reciprocal; and reciprocal union makes a one.

The conjunction of love is from what is reciprocal; and there is no Reciprocal in one's self alone. If there is supposed to be, it is from an imagined Reciprocal in others. Hence the Divine love must needs be and come forth in others...
By this (reception of the Divine good and truth) is the Reciprocal of love; for love is not possible unless it is reciprocal.
The conjunction is of the Lord with the Angel, and of the Angel with the Lord; therefore the conjunction is reciprocal. Explained. DP 28:2, Explained.
Thus a Reciprocal is necessary to conjunction. CL 61. CL 132:6.
What an Angel thinks, wills, speaks, and does... appears to be from himself. This causes the Reciprocal, by which is conjunction.

(Thus) an Angel has a Reciprocal for the sake of conjunction with the Lord; but the Reciprocal, regarded in its faculty, is not his, but the Lord's. Hence, if he abuses this Reciprocal he falls down from what is angelic. That the conjunction is reciprocal. Illustrated.
That the love... causes wisdom to be reciprocally conjoined with it. General article.
The reciprocal conjunction, or that of truth with good, is nothing at all. That they are reciprocally conjoined is from the life of good.

As perceptions and thoughts appear to the Angels as their own... there is an appearance that they conjoin themselves reciprocally with the Lord, when yet the Lord conjoins them with Himself. Explained... (Thus) the reciprocal conjunction of the Angels... is not from them, but as from them. DP 44:end.
That there is a reciprocal conjunction of man with the Lord. Illustrated.
Anyone can see that there is no conjunction of minds unless it is reciprocal; and that the Reciprocal conjoins. Explained.

(Therefore) the Lord provides that there shall be a Reciprocal with man. The Reciprocal with man is that the good which he wills and does from freedom, and the truth which from this willing he thinks and speaks according to reason, appear as if from him...
The reciprocal conjunction of man with the Lord is not from man, but from the Lord.
The expansions and compressions, or reciprocations of the organic forms of the mind.
For this is the Reciprocal of love which the Lord gives to everyone...

For man thinks and wills as from himself, and this as as from himself is the Reciprocal of conjunction; for conjunction without a Reciprocal is impossible, as there is no conjunction of an active with a passive without a reactive. God alone acts. Explained. TCR 588:2.

All the conjunction in the universe... is from the reciprocal accession of the one to the other, and that the other then wills to be a one with the other... Such is the reciprocal conjunction of the soul and the body... of the spirit with the sensory and motory organs... of the heart and the lungs... of the will and the understanding, etc. etc.
(Conjunction) becomes reciprocal when man acts from his freedom...
That the conjunction with the Lord is reciprocal, which is, that the Lord is in man, and man in the Lord. General article.
That conjunction is reciprocal. Illustrated.

As the conjunction is reciprocal, it necessarily follows, that man must conjoin himself with the Lord, in order that the Lord may conjoin Himself with him... In order that there may be this reciprocal conjunction, there has been given to man free choice... From this freedom flows forth his Reciprocal - that he can conjoin himself with the Lord, or with the devil. TCR 504:7.

It is to be lamented that the reciprocal conjunction of the Lord and man... is unknown in the Christian Church... That this reciprocal conjunction, on which the salvation of the human race depends, may be no longer... unknown, it shall be disclosed... by examples.
There are two reciprocations by which conjunction is effected; one alternate, and the other mutual. (Continued. See Conjoin.)
That this reciprocal conjunction of the Lord and man is through charity and faith. Explained.
A reciprocal undulation...
Those in conjugial love have a Reciprocal, and this in each and all things...
Thus there is given with man a Reciprocal, which is his new will.
The unition (of Divine truth and Divine good) is reciprocal. Signified.
No one perceives (the Word) unless he wants to perceive it as from himself. There must be this Reciprocal by man in order for him to receive the faculty of perceiving the Word. Explained. AE 616:2.
If there were no reception, there would be no Reciprocal, which makes what is of God to be as of man...
This Reciprocal is necessary to reformation.
In each thing of the Word there is the reciprocal unition of good and truth, which testifies that the Word is the Divine which proceeds from the Lord... Illustrated.
The perception is then reciprocal...
(The lungs) induce on the universal body... reciprocal motions...

The union of love and wisdom is reciprocal: love unites itself to wisdom, and wisdom reunites itself to love. Hence, love acts, and wisdom reacts: by this Reciprocal comes forth every effect. Such a union is reciprocal; and hence comes the reciprocation of the will and the understanding, etc.
Without this (appearance) there would be no Reciprocal.
That there is a reciprocal conjunction of love and wisdom... General article. DWis 2.
Therefore there is a reciprocal union; and thence the body acts from the soul; and not the soul through the body.
On reciprocal conjunction. General article.
